VOICE 110.name: Voice: Secondary
VOICE 110.description: Individual voice instruction, one hour per week. Bulletin credit max is 16 across repeated enrollments, offered every semester -- the Musical Theatre B.F.A. plan schedules this 4 times (8cr total, within the cap).

VOICE 412.name: Musical Theatre Voice V
VOICE 412.description: Musical theatre voice instruction, required of fourth-year Musical Theatre B.F.A. students. Bulletin lists program-standing eligibility in prose rather than an enforced course-code prereq.

VOICE 462.name: Musical Theatre Voice VI
VOICE 462.description: Continuation of the vocal approach and technique studied in Musical Theatre Voice V (VOICE 412). Bulletin describes this as a de facto content follow-on but lists no enforced course-code prereq.
